info.title: SmartGN - Support & Maintenance
info.description: Knowledge articles, external gas technicians, tickets, private photographs, technical visits, diagnoses and service ratings. Owns an independent PostgreSQL database and integrates through authenticated HTTP and durable events. Local fixtures do not establish productive external integration.
